subject: Disease mapping of COVID-19 cases by district

messages.author: b37e9112b1cfeb09
messages.subject: Disease mapping of COVID-19 cases by district
parts:
Dear all,
I have data for covid-19 organized by districts plus the total population for each district. What distribution do i use to district-specific relative risks?
Currently am using the code below

formula<-log(cases)~1 +f(ID, graph=KEN.adj, model="bym")+
  f(ID1, model="iid")

mod.nov<-inla(formula, family="gaussian",control.compute = list(dic=TRUE), data=shp@data)

Thanks in advance,
J

messages.author: 334c7505e0b5cf65
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Disease mapping of COVID-19 cases by district
parts:
Hi,

You can check the following for disease mapping with INLA:

https://www.paulamoraga.com/book-geospatial/

https://becarioprecario.bitbucket.io/inla-gitbook/ch-spatial.html

And maybe read the book by Waller and Gotway (for example) first to get a better grasp of the different models used in disease mapping. You need to account to the population in your model using an offset, for example.

Best,

Virgilio
